spec.claim_summary: Bitcoin is bought only when price is more than 5% below the most recent high, compared against daily dollar-cost averaging.
assumptions: Asset is BTCUSDT from Bitcoin mention in claim.
Timeframe 1d is from page context, not stated in claim text; chosen as most natural daily reading.
Most Recent High Price is vague on lookback; interpreted as highest high of prior 365 daily bars as 1-year high proxy; all-time-high reading was possible.
Entry uses daily close more than 5% below that high: close < 0.95 * highest_high(365).
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: daily $1 position sizing and averaging / DCA ladder with multiple concurrent holdings; engine tests single-position entry timing only.
Claim states no exit; max_hold_bars 3650 used as indefinite buy-and-hold proxy, the most common reading for accumulation setup.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: test window May 1, 2013 to May 23, 2021 comparison accounting; engine tests over all available history, period stored in claimed only.

evidence.quote: Don't Buy Until There's a Dip Greater Than 5% from the Most Recent High Price
